newsitem.title: USA: LaserSight names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: LaserSight names chief operating officer.

text.p: LaserSight Inc said Friday it named Richard Stensrud to the newly created position of chief operating officer.
Stensrud, who has operated a consulting firm serving companies in the health care industry, will have operational oversight for all the company's subsidiaries, it added.

In a statement, Michael Farris, president and chief executive officer, said he will now be free to direct his time toward implementing the company's strategic plan and securing more managed care contracts and acquiring practices.

LaserSight has four operating subsidiaries for laser manufacturing and international sales, third-party managed vision care administration, ophthalmic practice management, and health and vision care consulting services.
